name: @metrion/ingest
description: One authenticated HTTP endpoint any application in any language can POST metrics to. Per-project API key auth resolves tenancy (docs/adr/0005-api-key-determines-tenancy.md); writes go straight to the TimescaleDB hypertable @metrion/db migrates (docs/adr/0004-postgres-timescaledb-over-append-blob.md). No SDK required.
